dedupe_keys.name: treasure valley idaho irrigation canal network gis

description: This dataset maps the irrigation canal network of Idaho's Treasure Valley. Hawk Stone of the Idaho Department of Environmental Quality started from an existing canal coverage and built out the rest of the network from aerial imagery, discussions with the irrigation entities and substantial field checking; Taylor Tatum and Bridget Bittmann then updated feature names with diversion data, added features from imagery and grouped them into classes. It was published on HydroShare in 2022 as one compressed GIS archive of about 1.4 MB, a free download under a CC BY licence. Coverage is regional for one irrigated valley. Caveats: canal capacities and flows are not described, and the network reflects mapping up to 2022. Simulation uses: canal network topology for irrigation delivery and diversion models, capacity planning and drought adaptation. Related record: potential command areas of irrigation dams (data-potential-command-areas-irrigation-dams).
